description: Defines a Drupal plugin class 'NodeRevision' for creating views of node revision data within the Drupal CMS, including configuration for display options, filters, and access control.

classes.name: NodeRevision
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for creating a view wizard for node revisions, with methods to configure display options, filters, and access control.

methods.name: rowStyleOptions
methods.description: Overrides parent method to customize row style options by removing 'teasers' and 'full_posts'.

methods.name: defaultDisplayOptions
methods.description: Overrides parent method to set default display options, including access permissions and fields for 'changed' and 'title'.

methods.name: defaultDisplayFiltersUser
methods.description: Creates filters based on user input, particularly filtering by content type.

methods.name: buildDisplayOptions
methods.description: Builds display options, adding relationships for content revision nodes.
